preconditions.description: The length of the first bracket sequence s must be at most 200 characters.
The length of the second bracket sequence t must be at most 200 characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The first bracket sequence s must consist only of '(' and ')' characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '()' for c in t)
preconditions.description: The second bracket sequence t must consist only of '(' and ')' characters.

postconditions.description: The output must be a regular bracket sequence that contains both s and t as subsequences.
The output must be the shortest possible regular bracket sequence containing both s and t.
